name: Anant Raj Ltd.
about: Anant Raj Limited is primarily engaged in the real estate and infrastructure development business in India and Singapore. It develops and constructs residential townships, group housings, commercial developments, information and technology parks, malls, office complexes, affordable housings, data centres, hospitality, and serviced apartments. The company was formerly known as Anant Raj Industries Limited and changed its name to Anant Raj Limited in October 2012. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

verdict.label: Looks cheap
reasons: Price implies only ~22% a year growth, below the ~25% that history and analysts support, so expectations look modest.
PE of 27 is near the bottom of its range over the last 3 years (median 53), though that is a short history to judge by.
Since 2023, the price gain has been earned: earnings grew 49% a year while PE moved 37 → 27.
